title: [Prime, NSW, ACT, QLD] 21x Harris Farm Eggs Barn Laid 12pk 660g $32.39 Delivered @ Harris Farm via Amazon AU
body:
Deal: [Prime, NSW, ACT, QLD] 21x Harris Farm Eggs Barn Laid 12pk 660g $32.39 Delivered @ Harris Farm via Amazon AU

[node modules] only will buy if they have at least a year until expiry
[Crownanchor] You are looking at this the wrong way. Eggs are so much fun when they expire, you can throw them everywhere.
[The Fat Cat] I used to eat a dozen whole eggs scrambled for breakfast. I do not know if that was healthy or not O_o
[nubix] Shipped and sold by Harris Farm unfortunately, might have some luck in Wodonga :)
[genericozbargainer] Doubt it, no one with any luck lives in Wodonga.
[Wiadro] Currently unavailable.
We don't know when or if this item will be back in stock.
[RocketFish] Yes, but don't expect to be making sunny side ups after. Scramble then portion and freeze.
[freefall101] The way my Amazon boxes usually show up, they’ll probably come pre-scrambled too
[Fuzor] This is a first! They're moving into fresh foods
[Lizard Spock] If you're lucky, your local Harris Farm will not have all 21 cartons and you may end up with free eggs.
Who then loses out, the chicken or the egg?
[Shekster] We are going to single-handedly cause another egg shortage…
I tried to be somewhat considerate and got 15x instead with a couple 2kg tubs of yogurt
[alcadive] I misread this as being for 21 x eggs lol I was like that’s not a bargain
[WatchNerd] I like to check my eggs aren't cracked before buying. Do you think the delivery guy will wait while I check each one?
[Jasonofoz] Amazon provide free scrambling services at no extra charge!
[FastN] This is awesome. I got a nice protein combo!
[samsys] Hey guys. I orddred now and still was available.
[tekisei] I fomo'd and now going to eat quiche for the next 3 weeks.
[watwatwat] BargainsGrabber 6 min ago Comment unpublished. (Requested by Commenter)
Screw you, I had a good egg-related pun ready to go.
[BargainsGrabber] I was tired, read my cart incorrectly. Was ready to go with Amazon ever since some Japan deals were canned initially
[UncleRico] Great deal - wish it was available in my area.
Try as I might, I can never make an omelette without breaking some of these…
[skd100™] Thanks OP, great deal!
The FRESH60 code is $20 off each of your next 3 Harris Farm Markets orders when you spend $100 or more.
If you click qualifying items as OP mentioned, you can find other items which are 50% off.
So you don’t have to buy 21 cartons of eggs. I got 5 dozen eggs, 2 x 500g pistachios and 2 x 500g walnuts for $34.
